_comment_routing: The SPA owns every path except /api, which is proxied to the Cloudflare Worker. Keeping the API on the same origin means the browser never makes a cross-origin call, so there is no CORS preflight and no cookie/credential edge cases. Set API_WORKER_URL to the Worker's https URL in Vercel project settings.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://pagead2.googlesyndication.com https://www.googletagmanager.com; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; img-src 'self' data: https:; connect-src 'self' https:; frame-src https://www.google.com; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'

_comment_csp: script-src keeps 'unsafe-inline' because the built index.html inlines nothing but the Seo component injects JSON-LD, and Google's ad script requires it. If AdSense is never enabled, tighten script-src by removing both third-party origins. frame-ancestors 'none' blocks clickjacking; the Worker sets its own copy for API responses.
